en: The postcard shows a black and white photograph of a grand avenue with ornamental gardens and ornate multi-story buildings, likely from the late 19th or early 20th century. The scene captures the Esplanaden in Sundsvall, Sweden. There is Swedish handwriting on both the address and photo sides of the postcard. The stamp is a green 5 öre Swedish stamp with an image of a monarch, and the text includes 'Sundsvall. Esplanaden.' at the bottom.
